reclassify_proposed.reason: R's confint(parm='rho:...', method='wald') routes to an untransformed delta-method Wald distinct from method='fisher-z' (rows CI-ROUTE-031 vs 029/034). GLLVM.jl implements only the Fisher-z transformed-Wald for bounded [-1,1] correlations (confint_derived_wald.jl; CLAUDE.md confint_derived_wald.jl entry). No untransformed Wald for rho exists in the Julia port, and none is planned — the transformed-scale CI is the documented choice for a bounded correlation. Revisit only if a future R-parity requirement demands the untransformed variant.
